findings.title: Unsubscribe crashes when TopicUser row is missing
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb line 105-107, `tu = TopicUser.find_by(...)` can return nil (e.g. category watcher, first notification, never visited topic) and the next line does `tu.notification_level` with no nil guard. This raises NoMethodError and returns 500 instead of unsubscribing. Should use TopicUser.change/get-or-create with muted level.

findings.title: State-changing unsubscribe on GET enables CSRF/prefetch mutation
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb line 98, `TopicsController#unsubscribe` is routed as GET (config/routes.rb) and immediately mutates `tu.notification_level` and `tu.save!`. Visiting, prefetching, crawling or CSRF-loading the email link changes notification state without confirmation or POST/CSRF token. GET must be idempotent; mutation should require POST/PUT.

findings.title: Email unsubscribe requires login with no token, fails logged-out
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb line 28, `:unsubscribe` is in `ensure_logged_in`, and `Topic#unsubscribe_url` contains only `/t/slug/id/unsubscribe` with no key. Email links are typically opened logged-out or on another device, so clicking the per-topic link forces a login redirect and loses the intent instead of unsubscribing. Needs a signed/token auth like digest unsubscribe.

findings.title: Unsubscribe downgrades watchers to regular instead of muting
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb lines 107-111, if `notification_level > regular` it sets to `regular`, otherwise to `muted`. A watching/tracking user clicking 'stop receiving notifications' stays at regular and still gets reply/mention emails, contradicting the email copy 'To stop receiving notifications about this particular topic, click here' and the page copy 'You will stop receiving notifications'. Should set muted unconditionally.

findings.title: Direct save bypasses TopicUser side-effects
findings.body: In app/controllers/topics_controller.rb line 113, `tu.notification_level=` + `tu.save!` bypasses `TopicUser.change` which sets `notifications_changed_at`, `notifications_reason_id`, publishes MessageBus `notification_level_change` and updates tracking state. Consequence is stale UI, missing audit reason and inconsistent timestamps. Should call TopicUser.change.

findings.title: New unsubscribe_link requires unsubscribe_url, breaks emails missing it
findings.body: In lib/email/message_builder.rb lines 67 and 90, `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` now interpolates `%{unsubscribe_url}` (config/locales/server.en.yml). If any caller sets `add_unsubscribe_link: true` without `unsubscribe_url`, I18n raises MissingInterpolationArgument and email delivery fails. Only `send_notification_email` was updated; other present/future paths and queued jobs are fragile. Make interpolation optional or default.

findings.title: Assumes post.topic exists and offers mute for PMs
findings.body: In app/mailers/user_notifications.rb line 295, `unsubscribe_url: post.topic.unsubscribe_url` assumes `post.topic` is non-nil and meaningful. If topic is deleted/nil it raises NoMethodError in the mail job, and for private messages muting does not stop PM emails, so the link is misleading. Needs nil guard and PM handling.

findings.title: afterModel assumes details exists and ignores load failures
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/routes/topic-unsubscribe.js.es6 lines 6 and 14, `PostStream.loadTopicView` promise has no catch, and `afterModel` does `topic.set('details.notificationReasonText', null)` without checking `details`. If topic is invisible/deleted or has no details, this throws or leaves a blank page with unhandled rejection instead of 404/login. Needs guard and error handling.

findings.title: No coverage for per-topic unsubscribe behavior
findings.body: In spec/components/email/message_builder_spec.rb lines 169-180, the test adds `unsubscribe_url` param but never asserts it appears in body/HTML or in List-Unsubscribe, and there are no controller specs for TopicsController#unsubscribe (nil TopicUser, auth, GET side-effect, regular vs muted). The new feature can regress undetected.
